title: Gorgeous!
text: Gorgeous!. This ottoman is exactly as pictured. It comes fully assembled, minus screwing in the legs. The fabric is durable and the color is a cream base with a nice teal and brown. It’s just as beautiful as I’d hoped and the storage is large enough for a king size blanket with room to spare! Highly recommend!
